### 🇨🇳 中文更新日志
* 📂 **移动端文件管理智能面包屑与手势交互**：
  * **场景联动置换**：深入子目录时，快捷栏自动平滑折叠为横向滚动面包屑，释放 50px 以上纵向高度，浏览更多文件；
  * **路径友好易读**：物理路径人性化呈现（如 `/mnt/user` 显示为 `阵列共享`），点击任意前序目录即可秒级回跳；
  * **一键复制与快捷跳板**：点击或长按任意层级一键复制真实 Linux 绝对路径，末端提供快捷跳板直达“我的收藏”与“本地下载”；
  * **全端手势与羽化遮罩**：支持手机触屏滑动与电脑鼠标拖拽，边缘自然微羽化淡出，修复手动滑动后自动回弹复位的问题。
* ⚡ **SSH 隧道长连接自愈与原生硬件加速**：
  * **连接透明自愈**：彻底解决 SSH 动态隧道在长时间空闲后偶发的断网死循环，在网络恢复时自动静默重连；
  * **WebUI 动态转发提速**：容器 WebUI 转发接入底层 Rust 硬件 AES 加速引擎，配置 256KB 大缓冲，内网访问更流畅。
* 📶 **顶部导航栏实时网络延迟（RTT）监测**：
  * **极简素雅设计**：在顶栏服务别名后实时显示与 Unraid 宿主机的网络时延数值（如 `● 7.3.2 (PLUS) • dv • 4ms`），离线时自动隐藏；
  * **底层精准探活**：基于底层轻量网络探测直测真实网络时延，并引入平滑滤波算法，杜绝毫秒数字晃眼跳动。
* 🚀 **全平台多端性能同步升级**：
  * iOS、Android、macOS 及 Windows 同步升级原生底层传输与隧道加速引擎，跨端体验一致流畅。

### 🇬🇧 English Changelog
* 📂 **Mobile File Explorer Scene-Linked Breadcrumbs & Gestures**:
  * **Contextual Transition**: Automatically collapses shortcuts into a sleek breadcrumb bar in subfolders, freeing 50px+ vertical space;
  * **Humanized Paths**: Translates physical Linux paths (e.g. `/mnt/user` to `Shares`) with instant 1-tap jump to any ancestor folder;
  * **Path Copy & Quick Hub**: Tap or long-press any node to copy full Linux path; trailing shortcut hub for instant access to Favorites & Downloads;
  * **Fluid Drag & Edge Fade**: Supports touch swiping and desktop mouse dragging with feathered edges; fixed unwanted auto-retract on background refresh.
* ⚡ **SSH Self-Healing & Native Hardware AES Acceleration**:
  * **Transparent Reconnection**: Completely resolved idle timeout loop issues on SSH dynamic tunnels with seamless automatic self-healing;
  * **Accelerated WebUI Forwarding**: Dynamic port forwarding now runs on native Rust AES engine with 256KB buffers for line-rate throughput.
* 📶 **Real-Time Network Latency (RTT) Telemetry**:
  * **Minimalist UI**: Live display of network latency milliseconds right behind the server alias (e.g. `● 7.3.2 (PLUS) • dv • 4ms`), hidden when offline;
  * **Pure Network Handshake**: Accurately measures true network RTT with smooth filtering to prevent eye-straining number fluctuations.
* 🚀 **Cross-Platform Native Parity**:
  * Synchronized native high-performance engines across iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows for consistent multiplatform fluidity.
